mapper.select: SELECT A.MDRC_ID AS mdrcId, A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AS mdrcFomSeq, A.MDFM_ID AS mdfmId, A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ AS mdfmFomSeq, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'RDO062' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD) AS itemNm, A.MDF_REC_DTM::DATE AS writingDate, A.MDF_REC_DTM AS writingDateTime, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.WRTR_DEPT_CD) AS writingDeptNm, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.PT_MED_DEPT_CD) AS ptMedDeptNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.WRT_STF_NO) AS writerNm FROM ODS.S_MRDDRECM A WHERE A.MDRC_ID = ${mdrcId} AND A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = ${mdrcFomSeq}

SELECT A.MDFM_ID AS mdfmId, A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ AS mdfmFomSeq, A.MDFM_CLS_CD AS mdfmClsCd, A.MDFM_SCTN_SEQ AS mdfmSctnSeq FROM ODS.S_MRFMFSCD A WHERE A.MDFM_ID = ${mdfmId} AND A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ = ${mdfmFomSeq} ORDER BY A.MDFM_SCTN_SEQ

SELECT MDFM_SCTN_SEQ AS sectionSeq, MDFM_CPEM_ID AS id, UPR_MDFM_CPEM_ID AS parentId, MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD AS classType, ELMT_CCLS_CD AS controlType, MDFM_CPEM_CNTE AS value, ELMT_BSC_CNTE AS defaultValue FROM ODS.S_MRFMFCID A WHERE MDFM_ID = ${mdfmId} AND MDFM_FOM_SEQ = ${mdfmFomSeq} ORDER BY sectionSeq, id, parentId
